map.summary: A technical datasheet and supporting documentation for Texas Instruments’ SN54HC86/SN74HC86 HC86-family quad two-input XOR logic devices. It describes their operation, electrical and switching characteristics, ratings, package and pin options, applications, and practical design guidance for power supply, unused inputs, loading, layout, and thermal considerations. Extensive addenda cover orderable variants, lifecycle and compliance details, shipping formats, package dimensions, PCB land patterns and stencil guidance, plus support resources, handling cautions, and legal disclaimers.
map.shortDescription: Reference documentation for TI HC86-family quad XOR gates, covering device specifications, applications, ordering and package details, board design guidance, and legal notes.

sections.title: Overview of the SN74HC86/SN54HC86 quad XOR gates, including features, applications, packages, pin functions, and key specifications.
sections.summary: The SN74HC86 and SN54HC86 are quad 2-input XOR logic devices: each of four independent gates outputs A ⊕ B. The datasheet highlights buffered inputs, operation from 2 V to 6 V, fanout up to 10 LSTTL loads, and uses such as phase-difference detection and selectable inversion or buffering. It identifies available package options and pin assignments, and summarizes operating limits, thermal data, and electrical characteristics. The 74 and 54 versions cover different temperature ranges; the excerpt also notes absolute-maximum ratings and cautions that exceeding recommended conditions can affect device reliability.
sections.shortDescription: Overview of the SN74HC86/SN54HC86 quad XOR gates, including features, applications, packages, pin functions, and key specifications.

sections.title: Datasheet details for the SN74HC86/SN54HC86 XOR gates, including electrical performance, operation, and application and design guidance.
sections.summary: The SN74HC86 and SN54HC86 are quad two-input XOR devices. This section covers their electrical and switching characteristics, typical output behavior, measurement conditions, CMOS push-pull outputs, standard inputs, clamp diodes, and XOR truth table. It also presents a clock phase-difference detector application and design guidance for supply and power limits, unused inputs, output loading, input transition rates, decoupling, thermal effects, and application timing curves. Use a recommended VCC supply and place a 0.1 μF bypass capacitor near each supply terminal; parallel capacitors such as 0.1 μF and 1 μF can help filter noise across different frequencies.
sections.shortDescription: Summarizes SN74HC86/SN54HC86 XOR operation, performance, application examples, and practical supply, loading, and thermal design guidance.

sections.title: Layout Guidelines
sections.summary: Unused inputs on multiple-input or multichannel logic devices must never float, because undefined input voltages can produce undefined operation. Tie unused inputs to an appropriate logic high or low, based on the function and input voltage specifications. The example layout shows a 0.1 μF bypass capacitor close to the device, recommends a GND flood fill for signal isolation, noise reduction, and thermal dissipation, and depicts unused inputs tied to VCC while an unused output is left floating. Avoid 90-degree corners in signal traces.
sections.shortDescription: Explains how to handle unused logic inputs and illustrates recommended SN74HC86 board layout practices.

sections.title: Device and Documentation Support
sections.summary: Related documentation includes HCMOS Design Considerations, CMOS Power Consumption and CPD Calculation, and Designing with Logic. TI E2E forums provide engineering support, while their contributed content is supplied as-is and is not a TI specification. The section identifies TI E2E as a trademark, warns that ESD can damage the IC and recommends proper handling and installation precautions, and points readers to the TI Glossary. Mechanical, packaging, and orderable information follows and may change; consult the current browser-based datasheet for the latest information.
sections.shortDescription: Lists related technical references and support resources, and gives trademark, ESD handling, glossary, and documentation notes.

sections.title: Package Options and Orderable Information
sections.summary: The package option addendum lists orderable SN54HC86 and SN74HC86 variants, with package type and pin count, lifecycle status, order quantity and carrier, RoHS status, lead finish, moisture sensitivity, peak reflow rating, operating temperature, and package marking. Options include military-temperature SN54HC86 parts in LCCC, CDIP, and CFP packages and commercial SN74HC86 parts in SOIC, PDIP, SOP, and TSSOP packages. Some part numbers are obsolete, while others remain active; active tape-and-reel options include 2,000 units per order. The listed SN74HC86 SOP and TSSOP variants have 14 pins, with operating ranges varying by option, including −40 to 85 °C and −40 to 125 °C.
sections.shortDescription: Summarizes package, ordering, compliance, lifecycle, temperature, and marking details for SN54HC86 and SN74HC86 variants.

sections.title: SN54HC86 and SN74HC86 orderable variants
sections.summary: The table lists 20-pin LCCC and 14-pin CDIP or CFP SN54HC86-related parts, including military-temperature variants rated −55 to 125 °C, supplied in tubes and marked non-RoHS with SNPB lead finish. Commercial SN74HC86 entries include active SOIC, PDIP, SOP, and TSSOP options, alongside obsolete SOIC and TSSOP base part numbers. Active commercial variants are generally RoHS-compliant and rated −40 to 85 °C; G4 options extend to 125 °C. The table provides package quantities, carriers, lead finishes, moisture sensitivity ratings, and part markings.
sections.shortDescription: Presents a detailed orderable-parts table for military- and commercial-temperature SN54HC86 and SN74HC86 variants.

sections.title: Repeated SN54HC86 and SN74HC86 orderable-parts table
sections.summary: This section repeats the orderable-parts listings for military SN54HC86 variants in LCCC, CDIP, and CFP packages and commercial SN74HC86 variants in SOIC, PDIP, SOP, and TSSOP packages. Military variants are active, non-RoHS parts with a −55 to 125 °C operating range. Commercial listings include active options and obsolete SN74HC86D, SN74HC86DT, and SN74HC86PW base parts; active G4 variants are rated to 125 °C, while other active commercial parts are generally rated −40 to 85 °C. Packaging and marking details are included.
sections.shortDescription: Repeats the package, status, shipping, compliance, and temperature details for SN54HC86 and SN74HC86 orderable parts.

sections.title: Orderable-parts table: military variants and SOIC entries
sections.summary: The table starts with active SN54HC86-related LCCC, CDIP, and CFP parts, including military-temperature variants rated −55 to 125 °C. It then lists SN74HC86D as obsolete and SN74HC86DR and SN74HC86DR.A as active SOIC parts, each with 14 pins, a 2,500-unit large tape-and-reel quantity, RoHS-compliant NIPDAU finish, and a −40 to 85 °C operating range.
sections.shortDescription: Begins another orderable-parts table, listing military-temperature devices and the first SN74HC86 SOIC variants.

sections.title: Package and ordering details, lifecycle status, and compliance information for TI HC86-family parts.
sections.summary: The package option addendum lists TI’s SN74HC86/SN74HCS86 and SNJ54HC86 orderable variants, including status, package type and pin count, order quantities and carrier, RoHS and lead-finish details, reflow rating, operating-temperature range, and part marking. Most listed variants are active production parts; SN74HC86DT and SN74HC86PW are marked obsolete. The document also explains product-status, material-type, and RoHS definitions. Repeated SNJ54HC86 entries in the source are duplicates.
sections.shortDescription: Package and ordering details, lifecycle status, and compliance information for TI HC86-family parts.
